capabilities: Show a compact toolbar beside text selections for formatting, links, colours and block types
Add hover insert buttons and drag handles to move paragraphs and nested lists
Insert pages, dates, headings, lists, callouts and attachments via @ and / menus
Display file-type icons with custom icons and colours in the sidebar and tabs
Unify typography and paragraph rhythm, provide empty property rows with a themed date calendar, and switch Workspaces
extras: Mobile support is Beta with a limited feature set; the README advises testing in a separate vault and keeping backups. The previous Keyline companion must not run alongside it, and settings do not migrate automatically. No telemetry or plugin-owned network requests.
intentEvidence: With Keyline is an independently implemented successor to the integrated Keyline interactions plugin
motivation: To pair with the Keyline theme so Obsidian feels ready to use with less setup ("Less setup. More writing.").
problem: Obsidian ships no floating selection toolbar, block hover handles, @ mention menus, per-file-type icons or a guided blank-state property row.

relations.evidence: Pair With Keyline with the Keyline theme to make Obsidian feel ready to use
an independently implemented successor to the integrated Keyline interactions plugin

summary: Companion to the Keyline theme that adds selection toolbars, block drag handles, @ page/date and / insertion menus, file icons, typography and blank property entry.
